rules: A dependency without at least one concrete current Biology consumer is not retained.
The current supplemental runtime dependencies are redscript for Biology's additive/wrapper REDscript runtime and cybercmd solely to execute redscript's startup InvokeScc task without RED4ext/CET.
The E3 presentation preference is Biology-owned save state and does not justify a settings framework stack.
Whole-mod public activation belongs to the REDmod launcher sentinel rather than a second persisted preference.
A future worker requesting a new dependency must identify the exact feature, why vanilla/REDmod/current runtime cannot satisfy it, and the package/install consequence before this graph changes.
Bundled third-party components require pinned version/hash/license/provenance and exact per-file ownership.
No source gameplay/presentation mod may execute or be bundled.
